subject: Vendr profile reconciliation + QA batch upload plan
messages:
From: Vendr Security <security@vendr.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Lawrence <emma.lawrence@bluecrest.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T09:14:00Z
Subject: Missing items for BlueCrest profile - next steps

Hi Sean,

Thanks for starting the Vendr profile for BlueCrest. We reviewed the initial questionnaire and there are a few fields and pieces of evidence missing that the procurement team flagged:

- SSO metadata for the new tenant (IdP certificate + ACS URL)
- SOC 2 audit summary PDF (redacted allowed)
- A manifest of active service accounts and their owners

Can you confirm whether you can: 1) upload a batch CSV with the service account inventory, and 2) provide a temporary S3 link to the SOC 2 summary? If you prefer, we can also accept uploads through the portal but we find bulk CSV makes the QA pass faster.

Thanks,
Vendr Security

(attachment: vendr_review_notes_20270522.txt)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Vendr Security <security@vendr.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Emma Lawrence <emma.lawrence@bluecrest.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Missing items for BlueCrest profile - next steps

Hi — thanks for the clear list. We'll take the CSV route. Proposed plan:

1) I'll attach a draft inventory CSV with owner and last-used date. Ben will validate service-account scoping (read/write) and Monica will redacted-check the SOC 2 summary.
2) We will upload the SOC 2 PDF to a pre-signed S3 link (24h expiry) and paste the Vendr portal evidence reference in the portal notes.
3) Ben will also include the IdP metadata file; if the ACS URL needs to be masked for any reason we can provide it in the portal notes rather than the metadata file.

Timeline: we can have the CSV + S3 link by EOD 2027-05-23 if that works for you.

Sean
Sean Gallagher
Security Operations 
Redwood Inference
(attachment: sean_vendr_inventory_20270522.csv)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-22T14:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Missing items for BlueCrest profile - next steps

Sean —
I'll run a quick scoping check this afternoon. Two quick asks:

- For the CSV please include a column for "privilege_level" (service, admin, infra) and "owner_email".
- Flag any accounts older than 90 days with "last_used" for additional review.

I'll also prepare a short blurb we can paste into Vendr field "additional controls" describing our least-privilege enforcement and token rotation cadence.

Ben
Sr. Security Engineer
(attachment: evidence_manifest_v1.xlsx)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Lawrence <emma.lawrence@bluecrest.com>
Date: 2027-05-23T09:47:00Z
Subject: Re: Missing items for BlueCrest profile - next steps

Emma / BlueCrest team —
Quick check from the evidence side: we can provide a redacted SOC 2 summary (whitepaper-style) but we need to remove customer names/incident timelines. If you can confirm the minimum fields you need in the manifest (owner, last_used, privilege_level, service_purpose) I'll finalize the CSV.

If Vendr needs the IdP certificate in PEM format, include the portal field "IdP metadata" as the upload target; otherwise we should avoid posting certificates in comments.

I can upload the files to the portal once Sean sends them or share the S3 link for the SOC 2 summary.

Monica
Vendor Risk Analyst
Redwood Inference

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Vendr Security <security@vendr.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Emma Lawrence <emma.lawrence@bluecrest.com>
Date: 2027-05-25T17:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Missing items for BlueCrest profile - next steps

Thanks all — quick status update and action items: 

- CSV uploaded (see attached). It uses columns: service_name, owner_email, privilege_level, last_used, service_purpose. Any rows with last_used > 90 days are tagged "review_needed".
- SOC 2 summary uploaded to S3 (pre-signed link): https://s3.redwood.ai/pre-signed/bluecrest-soc2-2027-05-25.pdf (expires in 48h).
- IdP metadata file attached to this thread; also pasted into Vendr portal under "IdP metadata".

Action owners: Ben to paste the least-privilege blurb into the Vendr "additional controls" field; Monica to run quick redaction QA on the uploaded PDF; Vendr to confirm receipt and run QA pass.

Thanks,
Sean
Security Operations
Redwood Inference
(attachments: sean_vendr_inventory_20270522.csv; bluecrest_soc2_summary_20270525.pdf; bluecrest_idp_metadata.xml)
